clauses.statement: OutcomeCase create/read/evaluate API は、成果・制約・明示的な closure authority・参照・参照解決状態・追記専用 evaluation history・revision・時刻を OutcomeCase 専用 record として扱い、既存 RunReceipt v1 schema を変更しない。

test_refs.case: creates the required control-plane record with an explicit external state

clauses.statement: closed は technical confirmed、初回から保持された全参照 RunReceipt confirmed、external readback confirm、constraints satisfied、project/capability confirmed、認証済み actor の明示 authority の同時成立でのみ導出する。評価 payload は既存 RunReceipt ref を削除できず、各 retained ref を診断する。

test_refs.case: retains every previously stored receipt ref, appends the evaluation history, and diagnoses all retained refs before close
wires the authenticated route actor into actual service-layer closure authority

test_pattern.must_cover: retains every previously stored receipt ref, appends the evaluation history, and diagnoses all retained refs before close

clauses.statement: HTTP 200、テスト、保存、デプロイ、欠落 receipt、external no_data、unknown constraints は close の証拠へ自動変換しない。

test_refs.case: does not close from technical evidence when receipt readback is unconfirmed

clauses.statement: authoritative project/capability resolver が未解決、registry 未適用、または利用不能なら理由付き unresolved を保存し、close を禁止する。request の evaluator 文字列は認可根拠にしない。

test_refs.case: represents an absent capability registry as unresolved instead of inferring authority
records unresolved authoritative references and forbids closure

clauses.statement: OutcomeCase schema は established Info SSOT idempotent apply bundle と readback に登録される。本 Story は Graph write、production migration、deploy を実行しない。

test_refs.case: runs schema, RLS, readback and smoke in fail-closed single-transaction mode

open_questions.question: production migration and Graph entity lifecycle remain explicitly outside v1 local implementation evidence
